title: Standard Query Operators Overview
description: A comprehensive reference of all LINQ standard query operators organized by functionality.

data.text: Standard Query Operators in LINQ are extension methods for `IEnumerable<T>` and `IQueryable<T>` types. They are defined in the `System.Linq.Enumerable` and `System.Linq.Queryable` classes. There are over 50 standard query operators available in LINQ.

rows: Aggregate, Average, Count, LongCount, Max, Min, Sum
ElementAt, ElementAtOrDefault, First, FirstOrDefault, Last, LastOrDefault, Single, SingleOrDefault
AsEnumerable, AsQueryable, Cast, ToArray, ToDictionary, ToList

data.text: Standard query operators in query syntax are converted into extension methods at compile time. Both syntaxes produce the same result.
Operators Only Available in Method Syntax
Some operators are only available in method syntax and not in C# query syntax:

items: **Aggregation**: Count, Sum, Average, Max, Min, Aggregate

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Classified by functionality: filtering, sorting, grouping, etc.
Query syntax converts to method syntax at compile time
Some operators are only available in method syntax
data.takeaway: Congratulations! You've completed the LINQ course. You now have a comprehensive understanding of LINQ from fundamentals to advanced concepts.
